summary: Frontend-only regression testing completed for Reels/Motion Shelf whitespace bug on preview URL; featured layout and interactions verified.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css is very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk; consider splitting section-specific styles into smaller scoped files.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://micro-moments-8.preview.emergentagent.com. Featured reel remains left-aligned and wide. Right-side featured stack now renders compact wide cards (project-video-card-4 and project-video-card-7), avoiding tall portrait placement. Hidden reels [1,9,14,15,18,21,22] are not rendered. Visible reel numbering is sequential (01-15). Computed gap from featured card bottom to masonry top is ~34.48px (normal spacing, no large blank white area). Clicking reel opens modal and Escape closes it.
rca of the issue: Prior large whitespace was caused by selecting first two masonry items for side stack, which could include tall portrait cards. Current implementation filters side stack to aspectRatio > 1.2 and takes first two wide entries, preventing tall tiles from expanding side-stack height and pushing lower content down.
